name: inhaus-app-video
description: Promo video for the InHaus App, made with Remotion. Not part of the website build.

scripts.web: ffmpeg -y -i out/inhaus-app-master.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 24 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 160k ../public/assets/video/inhaus-app.mp4
scripts.poster: remotion still src/index.ts Poster out/poster.png --frame=240 && ffmpeg -y -i out/poster.png -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libwebp -quality 82 ../public/assets/video/inhaus-app-poster.webp
